prompt.alinti: There's a repo that lets Claude use almost any software on your computer just by asking.
Most software is built for people clicking buttons, so AI has a tough time using it like Claude.
This repo, CLI Anything, gives each app a text version of its controls.
So basically, it turns any software into a CLI.
There's already a hub with dozens of apps ready to go.
OBS for recording YouTubes, Zoom, Obsidian, even Blender.
Install one of these, and you just tell Claude what you want done.
If your app isn't there yet, you point the repo at the app's code, and it builds the CLI for you.
Comment 'apps' down below, and I'll send you the repo.
